name: lokier-late
description: cart plays his recording into the Apartments, holds back out of Lokier's sight (at the back of the room: on CS2 Mirage the window's sill hides him there), then peeks the window about 2.5 s late: Lokier's scripted hit lands about 1 s after he sees cart, and cart kills him for real about 2.6 s after the recorded kill. Then he walks his recorded way (the Balcony drop, B site) to Shop, in by the Shop door (T2: on CS2 the recording's way in is a jump through the Market window, which a late walker can't time), and plays his recording again.
